name: Beckhoff RT x64 / OIP conveyor

inputs.EStopHealthy: TRUE means healthy; ordinary PLC status, not safety rated
inputs.PartSensor: physical photoeye; rising edges while Motor count

outputs.Horn: warning horn command during the delay; represented visually, no acoustic horn model

scope: The OIP IEC program is a separately authored implementation of this contract, not execution of the native TcPOU. Native runtime correspondence requires a separate vendor run.

fault_expectations.sensor_stuck: a held input counts once; report actual process consequences, not an invented diagnostic
fault_expectations.jam: actual cargo is immobilized by physics fault and resumes after release
fault_expectations.communication_loss: OIP fault injection de-energizes outputs in its internal test harness; not a measured ADS cable loss

recovery: release StartPB before permissive recovery; reset alone must not start. Held StartPB behavior is level-sensitive in the original native seal-in, not a safety-rated restart interlock.
counter_change: PartPulse := PartSensor AND NOT LastPartSensor, evaluated every scan independently of Motor. CTU counts Motor AND PartPulse.
